[dramatic, mysterious] This onion has a chemical weapon.
[playful] And today... it's aimed at Papa.
[smug, scoffs] Pfft. पापा डज़ंट क्राई. नॉट ईवन एट वेडिंग्स.
[excited, quick] CHOP! The knife bursts the onion's tiny cells.
Two chemicals inside mix... and make a gas.
It floats up, stings his eyes, and they flood with tears to wash it out.
[sobbing loudly, voice cracking] आई एम नॉट क्राइंग! द अनियन स्टार्टेड इट!
[cheerful] Tip: chill the onion first, and use a sharp knife. Less gas, fewer tears.
[sweetly] गुड. नाउ कट फाइव किलो... फॉर द वेडिंग.
